rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for putting separate things, amounts, or activities together.

example.english: Let's combine the two sets of information and look at them together.
example.traditional: 我哋夾埋兩份資料一齊睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaap3 maai4 loeng5 fan6 zi1 liu2 jat1 cai4 tai2

rows.note: Use this when physically mixing ingredients or other substances together.

example.english: Combine the vegetables and meat together in the bowl.
example.traditional: 將啲菜同啲肉喺個碗度撈埋一齊。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 di1 coi3 tung4 di1 juk6 hai2 go3 wun2 dou6 lou1 maai4 jat1 cai4

rows.note: Use this more formal verb for combining ideas, features, or qualities, especially in writing or presentations.

example.english: This design can combine visual appeal with practicality.
example.traditional: 呢個設計結合美觀同實用性。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 cit3 gai3 git3 hap6 mei5 gun1 tung4 sat6 jung6 sing3

rows.note: Use this construction when one person or thing has two qualities at the same time.

example.english: This phone can combine a light build with fast performance.
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jau6 hing1 jau6 faai3
